title: Scrape
description:
Deal 7 damage.
Draw 4 cards.
Discard all cards drawn this way that do not cost 0 Energy.
upgraded_description:
Deal 10 damage.
Draw 5 cards.
Discard all cards drawn this way that do not cost 0 Energy.
notes: Automatically discards non-free cards drawn by this card, effectively drawing only free cards while also dealing damage.
